1. Project Schedule and Progress Control

• Monitor overall project progress against the approved Level 1 and detailed construction schedules.
• Review contractor schedules, look-ahead plans, milestones, and recovery plans.
• Identify schedule deviations, critical activities, potential delays, and their impact on project completion.
• Coordinate corrective and recovery actions with contractors and relevant project stakeholders.
• Consolidate physical progress reports from site supervisors and validate reported progress before submission to management.

2. Site Team Coordination

• Coordinate the activities of Site Civil Supervisors, Site M&E Supervisors, and other assigned site personnel.
• Ensure that site monitoring activities and reporting are aligned with project priorities.
• Coordinate interfaces between civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, and other disciplines.
• Consolidate site issues, assign follow-up responsibilities, and monitor action closure.
• Conduct regular project coordination meetings and follow up on agreed actions.

3. Contractor Performance Management

• Monitor contractor performance against contractual scope, schedule, quality, and HSE requirements.
• Evaluate the adequacy of contractor manpower, equipment, materials, and construction resources.
• Identify recurring performance issues and require action plans through the established project management process.
• Review progress claims and supporting site records within the delegated verification authority.
• Escalate significant contractual issues, variations, claims, and persistent non-compliance to the Construction Management Manager.

4. Quality, HSE, and Technical Coordination

• Monitor compliance with approved drawings, specifications, inspection plans, and project standards.
• Coordinate resolution of technical queries, design discrepancies, and site constraints with relevant engineering teams and consultants.
• Monitor major quality issues, non-conformities, and outstanding corrective actions.
• Coordinate with HSE personnel to ensure that significant safety risks are addressed.
• Ensure that proposed changes are reviewed and approved by authorized parties before implementation.

5. Project Reporting and Management Dashboard

• Prepare consolidated weekly and monthly project status reports.
• Maintain an overall view of schedule performance, physical progress, key milestones, risks, and outstanding issues.
• Prepare and update project dashboards, milestone trackers, action registers, and progress curves where required.
• Highlight negative trends, critical delays, resource constraints, and decisions requiring management intervention.
• Ensure that reported project information is accurate, consistent, and supported by site records.

6. Cost, Risk, and Change Monitoring

• Monitor project cost status and commitments against the approved budget in coordination with the relevant cost control team.
• Track potential variations, additional works, claims, and changes that may affect project cost or completion dates.
• Maintain a project risk and issue register and coordinate mitigation actions.
• Assess the potential impact of construction changes on schedule, cost, quality, and operational requirements.
• Escalate matters requiring commercial, contractual, or management approval.

7. Project Completion and Handover

• Coordinate completion planning, testing, inspections, and handover activities.
• Monitor punch-list closure, outstanding defects, and contractor close-out commitments.
• Coordinate collection and review of as-built drawings, operation and maintenance documents, and other required handover records.
• Ensure outstanding project matters are tracked through final acceptance and close-out.

Job Qualifications – Project Coordinator

1. Education

• Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
• Professional certifications in project management or construction management are an advantage.

2. Work Experience

• Minimum 5–8 years of experience in construction, project management, or construction management.
• Proven experience coordinating construction projects from planning through execution and handover.
• Experience monitoring contractors, project schedules, physical progress, and construction performance.
• Experience working on the Owner's or Consultant's side is preferred.
• Experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously is an advantage.

3. Technical Competencies

• Strong understanding of construction project planning, scheduling, monitoring, and control.
• Ability to review and monitor Level 1 project schedules, detailed construction schedules, milestone plans, and recovery schedules.
• Ability to analyze planned versus actual progress, identify schedule deviations, and assess potential impacts on project completion.
• Understanding of civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, and electrical construction interfaces.
• Knowledge of construction quality management, HSE requirements, risk management, and contractual obligations.
• Ability to review contractor performance, resource adequacy, progress claims, variations, and potential project delays.
• Understanding of project cost monitoring, budget control, and change management is an advantage.

4. Project Reporting and Computer Skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including progress tracking, data analysis, and reporting dashboards.
• Proficient in Microsoft Project or Primavera P6 for schedule review and monitoring.
• Ability to prepare project status reports, milestone trackers, progress curves, risk registers, and management dashboards.
• Ability to consolidate project information and translate site data into clear management reports.
• Proficiency in PowerPoint for management presentations is an advantage.
• Familiarity with Power BI or other data visualization tools is an advantage.

5. Core Competencies

• Strong coordination, planning, and organizational skills.
• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to identify critical issues, evaluate impacts, and recommend corrective actions.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to manage priorities and coordinate multiple workstreams simultaneously.
• Strong follow-up discipline to ensure action items are completed within agreed deadlines.
• High integrity, accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to project objectives.
• Ability to communicate project risks and performance issues clearly to management.

6. Other Requirements

• Willing to travel to project sites and attend project coordination meetings as required.
• Able to work under tight project deadlines and manage competing priorities.
• Professional proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia; working proficiency in English is preferred.
• Able to prepare structured reports and communicate effectively with contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
